target_customer: Veterinary clinics and reference labs needing fast hematology and cytology reads
problem: Veterinarians wait on slow or costly lab diagnostics. Moichor uses AI and computer vision, with pathologists in the loop, to provide preliminary results in as little as 15 minutes.
business_model: Diagnostics service and platform sold to veterinary practices, with distribution partnerships

founders.name: Shevy Karbasi
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page without background.

founders.name: Matthew Chen
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him; CB Insights search summary calls him founder and COO.

founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page without background.

competitors.name: IDEXX SediVue Dx
competitors.what: In-clinic analyzer with AI evaluation of urine sediment

competitors.name: Zoetis Vetscan Imagyst
competitors.what: AI enabled in-clinic analyzer with digital cytology

technical_complexity.rationale: Species specific image models for blood and cytology need large reference libraries, pathologist labelling and sample prep hardware or workflow.

defensibility.rationale: Moichor aims to build the world's largest species specific reference interval library, which would compound, but large diagnostics firms have distribution.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents added AI features; Zomedica instead signed a distribution deal with Moichor in February 2026.

market_need_then: Vet clinics rely on outside labs for cytology and hematology with delays and cost; the YC pitch is more accurate and affordable diagnostics.

branding.name_origin: A third party brand page says the name derives from two Greek mythological names, with no detail; unconfirmed.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive but hard to say or spell invented name; no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Moichor joined YC in Winter 2021, raised about $4M seed led by Neotribe Ventures, built the Pathview AI diagnostics product, and by February 2026 had a national distribution agreement with Zomedica. It is still active with about 29 staff. Later funding is unconfirmed, and strong incumbents in veterinary diagnostics remain the main risk.
notes: The moichor.com fetch returned 404 and the finsmes fetch returned 403, so seed details come from search summaries of FinSMEs and Pet Insight; Seedtable dates it April 2021 (aggregator). CB Insights lists a 6.22M seed in February 2023 and 11.39M total over four rounds, Craft lists 9M, Dealroom 10M to 50M; all unverified and not recorded. Founding year varies (2017, 2019). Zoetis competitor source is a 2026 Zomedica release, undated for the batch. Outcome search found no layoffs or acquisition.
